content: git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD gives the default branch but is NOT guaranteed to exist on a fresh clone/registration (errors 'not a symbolic ref' if never set locally). Robust determination needs a fallback chain: try symbolic-ref first; on failure, fall back to the current local HEAD branch name (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) or query the remote directly (git ls-remote --symref origin HEAD). git remote set-head origin <branch> can (re)establish the local ref but git fetch does not auto-refresh it.
